description: The file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing 'Note' entities in a database, providing methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting notes using Room persistence library annotations.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for Note entities, annotated with Room annotations for ORM functionalities.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of all notes ordered by update time descending.

methods.name: observeSearch
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of notes matching search query in title or content, ordered by update time descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Suspending function to retrieve a Note by its unique ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Note into the database with conflict strategy to replace existing.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Note in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Note from the database.
